Row.Text: The Queen's Lair grants 2 Spawn Points per turn, and up to two Brood Chambers grant 1 each. Hostile major-civilization and city-state military kills grant 4 Spawn Points and 1 Evolution Point. The first five eligible barbarian kills in each era grant 1 Spawn Point each. Open the Arachnid Empire panel to spawn specialized units and purchase permanent evolutions. Spawned units occupy Control Points. Losing the original capital suspends passive income, spawning and evolution purchases.

Spend early Spawn Points on reinforcements and earn Evolution Points through military combat. Build two Brood Chambers for the full passive income. Develop Intelligence for a larger swarm, Venom Glands for ranged attrition, or Chitin Armour for a durable front line. Guard the Queen's Lair to keep the Brood growing.

The Brood learned to read the world through its silk. The tremor of a single boot could travel from the outer tunnels to the royal chamber, where scouts relayed its direction by plucking the strands. From that first network the Arachnid Empire grew. Its soldiers still deliver every discovery in the same way: one tug for danger, two for prey, three for a weakness worth carrying into the next generation.

The Queen's Lair produces 2 Spawn Points per turn. Up to two Brood Chambers add 1 each. Defeating a hostile major or city-state military unit grants 4 SP and 1 EP. The first five eligible barbarian military kills each era grant 1 SP each. The original capital must be owned to receive passive income and spend SP or EP. Combat income is retained during occupation.

The Brood starts with 3 Control Points. A Broodling costs 45 SP and 1 CP. Venom Spiders cost 65 SP and 2 CP and require Venom Glands. Armoured Spiders cost 80 SP and 2 CP and require Chitin Armour. Add 15 SP per era after Ancient. Successful spawns share a cooldown of 1/1/2/3 turns on Quick/Standard/Epic/Marathon. Upgrades retain specialization. CP is released on death or permanent transfer. Use the Evolution tab to see era requirements, prerequisites and bonuses.

Every fallen enemy brings us closer to perfection.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Queen never forgets the shape of an enemy. She remembers how shield rims wore the silk, how bronze parted the shells of her first defenders, and how the surviving hatchlings found their way through the smoke. From the royal nest she directs the weaving of each new generation. The loss of a tunnel is a lesson. The loss of her lair is the one defeat she can feel in every strand.

Every fallen enemy brings us closer to perfection.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The fate of the Queen follows the original capital. Occupation halts passive Spawn Points and access to spawning and evolution purchases. Existing soldiers, evolutions, resources, and the Intelligence II Science bonus remain. Recover the original city to restore the suspended abilities.

Before the first kingdom raised its walls, the Brood had already learned the language of survival. Beneath the earth, generations fought and perished, leaving their strength to those that followed. From this struggle arose the Spider Queen, sovereign of an empire that could change faster than its enemies could learn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Great Queen, your enemies possess weapons, cities and armies. You possess the strength of every brood that came before you. Let battle nourish your children, and let each generation surpass the last.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Will your descendants weave their dominion across the world? Can you build a civilization that stands the test of time?
Arachnid replacement for the Archer. Ranged Strength 8 instead of 7. Venom is exclusive to the Venom Spider specialization.
Use the Black Widow like an Archer, with greater Ranged Strength. A Widow trained or purchased in a city consumes no Control Points.

A Widow was identified by the red hourglass on its abdomen and the sudden quiet that followed it. Hunters found that Widow silk could hold the tension of a fully drawn bow. The first line of defenders learned to fire through narrow cracks in the cavern walls, where an enemy could see the glimmer of the thread a heartbeat before release.

Replaces the Barracks and retains its experience benefits. Generates 1 Spawn Point per turn while the original capital is held. Up to two chambers contribute. After Intelligence II, all owned Brood Chambers also provide 1 Science.
Build two Chambers to maximize passive Spawn Point income. After Intelligence II, every owned Chamber produces Science, including those beyond the Spawn Point cap.

Silk partitions separate broods according to their age. At the entrance, veterans lay down trails that teach hatchlings to identify friend, foe and food. Farther in, shed shells are sorted by thickness and examined for fractures. The keepers can trace the lineage of an entire army through the material left behind on those shelves.
I am the Spider Queen. Your steps have reached my lair through a thousand strands. Speak, and I will decide which ones to keep.
